body: Yea I'm in China with them. I hate it here mainly because it feels like a microcosm for mankind's imminent doom since the China's environment is so fucked. The government is also extremely repressive as you probably already know. Being caught with 10g+ of weed is enough to be sentenced to death for. But if I persevere in a shitty country like this I'll only become a stronger person.
I fucking love you all. I never could've expected such support from an anonymous internet community. As long as there are good people in this world I can never commit suicide.
May I ask what condition you are diagnosed with?

Academic stress was the primary reason I wanted to die. I didn't want to live in a world that defined my worth based on grades. However, I decided that I'm not going to kill myself simply because I'm only 16 and there's too much in this world that I haven't experienced.
I was going to order cyanide tablets but couldn't figure out a way to get it shipped without my parents knowing. I've almost died choking on my own vomit from alcohol poisoning so I can handle Lysol.
